notice: Starting palette for the MVP, not a catalogue. Each property records the supplier's own words (supporting_text) separately from MOTIF's reading of them (motif_interpretation, a design_rule). A supplier's qualitative description does not scientifically validate MOTIF's axis mapping or any engine score: profiles, weights, and scores are design parameters. No dosage, safety, or regulatory assessment is given; concentration ranges in supplier sheets are deliberately not copied.

status_values.unverified_excerpt: Supplier page located by web search; the descriptor comes from a search excerpt. Not usable in live matching.
status_values.verified_full_page: Checked against the complete supplier page or technical sheet; the record names the URL, access date and the supporting text.

verification.live_matching_rule: The engine uses only properties whose verification status is verified_full_page. Unverified properties are used only in the explicitly labelled design preview (--allow-unverified-materials).

t2_attempt.result: 7 of 8 materials verified from full supplier pages

blocked.cause: site bot protection (Cloudflare); the environment proxy established the connection

t2_attempt.intermittent: studio.dsm-firmenich.com answered 403 (Imperva bot protection); the equivalent firmenich.com technical sheets were used instead (one sheet needed a single plain retry).

profile_rules.values: Each axis is a pole name or absent. Absent means MOTIF makes no claim about the material on that axis, never neutral.
profile_rules.basis: A pole is assigned only when a supplier descriptor term points to it (listed in 'basis_terms'); conflicting descriptors leave the axis absent and are listed under 'uncertainties'.
profile_rules.natural_synthetic_note: The axis is an aesthetic impression, not ingredient origin; 'origin' is recorded separately.

basis_vocabulary.note: MOTIF's design reading of supplier words (design_rule, not supplier claims). Applied consistently across materials; an explicit contrast in the source (for example 'rough ... but also round') leaves the axis absent.

materials.name: HEDIONE®
materials.identity: methyl dihydrojasmonate; supplier name 'Cyclopentaneacetic acid, 3-oxo-2-pentyl-, methyl ester'; dsm-firmenich product 964898

source.descriptor_excerpt: An elegant, transparent floral, jasmine note with citrus freshness. HEDIONE develops a beautiful natural smoothness and radiance ... does bestow presence, noticeability, and diffusion.

uncertainties: The sheet also calls the material 'by itself quietly understated'; projection is read from its stated effect in a perfume.
The sheet says 'natural smoothness'; natural_synthetic is left absent because the phrase qualifies smoothness, not the overall impression.

light_dense.supporting_text: An elegant, transparent floral, jasmine note with citrus freshness.

raw_polished.supporting_text: An elegant, transparent floral ... develops a beautiful natural smoothness and radiance

intimate_projecting.supporting_text: It does not necessarily increase strength, but does bestow presence, noticeability, and diffusion.

materials.name: Bergamot oil (Italy)
materials.identity: Citrus bergamia peel oil; grades differ by supplier and treatment (for example bergapten-reduced)

source.document: Givaudan product page Bergamot Oil Italy
source.descriptor_excerpt: CITRUS · Fresh, Zesty, Lavender-like. With its extremely rich, sweet and fruity top note ... brings a beautifully bright and sparkling citrus facet ... to bring freshness and naturalness.

uncertainties: The same page lists 'Fresh, Zesty'; sweetness is one facet, not the whole impression.
'extremely rich' could suggest weight; 'rich' is not in the basis vocabulary, so light rests on 'bright', 'sparkling' and top-note use.
Grade and phototoxicity restrictions are the perfumer's decision; not assessed here.

light_dense.supporting_text: this oil brings a beautifully bright and sparkling citrus facet to fragrances ... used in floral top notes

natural_synthetic.supporting_text: bergamot has been used in all types of perfume to bring freshness and naturalness to the fragrance
natural_synthetic.motif_interpretation: 'naturalness' read as a natural impression (design; not a claim about ingredient origin)

sweet_dry.supporting_text: With its extremely rich, sweet and fruity top note

materials.name: ISO E SUPER®
materials.kind: single material (isomer mixture, specific trade grade)

source.descriptor_excerpt: smooth, woody, amber with a 'velvet'-like sensation; imparts fullness and subtle strength

uncertainties: 'fullness' could suggest density, 'subtle' the opposite; light_dense left absent.

raw_polished.blocked: HTTP 403 from the supplier site's Cloudflare bot protection on 2026-10-06

materials.name: AMBROX® SUPER
materials.identity: dsm-firmenich product 909158 (Ambrox family; produced by white biotechnology since 2016 per supplier)

source.descriptor_excerpt: Extremely powerful and elegant ambery odor with a musky, woody tonality ... promises of sleek elegance and powerful iconic ambery signature ... highly diffusive and brings a unique ambery effect from top notes to dry down.

uncertainties: 'Powerful' is about intensity; reading it as density is MOTIF's creative mapping.
The sheet calls the profile 'more natural, more animalic' than CETALOX; this relative statement is not used.

light_dense.supporting_text: Extremely powerful and elegant ambery odor with a musky, woody tonality.
light_dense.motif_interpretation: 'extremely powerful' read as dense (design; the sheet describes strength, MOTIF reads it as perceived weight)

raw_polished.supporting_text: delivers all the promises of sleek elegance and powerful iconic ambery signature

intimate_projecting.supporting_text: AMBROX SUPER is highly diffusive and brings a unique ambery effect from top notes to dry down.
